ids.description: Ids of the entries confirmed this round. Each must be a live (non-stale, non-superseded) CONFIRMED entry in this repository's KB; any other id is skipped and reported in skipped. An empty list makes no commit.

baseBranch.description: The sprint's target base branch (the branch the work merges into). Written to provenance.branch.

baseCommit.description: The base commit the entries were verified against. Written to provenance.commit.
